cases.original_code:
def fetch_user(cursor, username):
    return cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '{username}'").fetchall()
cases.vulnerability_description: SQL string interpolation in fetch_user. Fix by using parameterized query: cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ?", (username,)).
